body:
One element can differ from its component's normal look, using a small closed set of properties.

### Do

- Add overrides to the validator's table: fill, border, text color, size and padding.
- Each takes a theme token or a literal value, and literal values are validated by kind, such as a color or a number.
- The renderer applies an override on top of the component and its variant.
- No free-form style text: anything outside this set is refused.

### Acceptance

- Tests: each override draws with a token and with a literal, an override beats the variant, a badly formed literal is refused, and an unknown property is refused, naming the element.

### Left out

Other style properties, and "promote to token" for literal values.
title: ui: per-element styling
